games.title: Grammar Maze
games.description: A torch-lit 3D maze for the classroom. Every fork is an English question: choose the sign with the right answer and the class walks that way. Four zones lead to the gold, with timers, monsters, and topics for grades 10–12.

games.title: Mila Quest
games.description: A 3D running game for English vocabulary: 8 worlds, 56 stages, bosses, and difficulty settings.

games.title: Word Detective (Demo)
games.description: DEMO · Parts of speech, word forms, prefixes and tenses for grades 10–12. Practice by topic with hints and explanations, a V1·V2·V3 verb drill, a reference page, a 30-question Bagrut-style exam, a class competition with codes, and a live team game on the projector.

games.title: Word Race
games.description: A live English quiz race for the whole class. The teacher opens a room (online, or on the projector with a big code and QR), students join from any device with a name and one of 8 runners, and every correct answer moves their runner up the track. Translation, vocabulary, grammar, missing-letter and listening questions, six difficulty levels, and a podium at the finish.

games.title: Word Blast
games.description: A calm bubble shooter for English practice. A sentence with a gap, a question or a word to translate appears under the board, and a few bubbles carry possible answers: aim the cannon and hit the right word. Correct hits pop it with its same-colour neighbours and loose bubbles fall into bonus baskets. Six levels, gap sentences, verb questions, translation, and the teacher's own word list with a student link and QR.
